scope: Every current local git ls-files --others --exclude-standard -z path; source, documentation, configuration and report payloads, not ignored datasets
limitations: Local reachable Git objects, not proof of independent disaster recovery or identical Linux asset files.
CRLF-to-LF recovery requires the stated conversion; raw originals remain in place.
Recovery identity does not prove main adoption, absence of use, dependency closure or deletion safety.
Snapshot excludes ignored data, checkpoints and files subsequently created by other windows.
